edges.name: Pendle rule (PT when implied > trailing30 + 200bp)

top3_loss_modes.detail: bias measured in falling-rate/points era; Fed hiking since Sep-2026; realized overtakes implied -> excess negative
hit 92% from ~4 episodes; forward hit 60-75%; bootstrap CI with 7d blocks overstates significance
candidates $3-7M TVL Monad; ask+slippage 10-40bp round trip; TVL collapse in final week widens spreads

missing_data: signal spread history >90d on live candidates

edges.name: FLB harvest (buy >=90c Politics/Finance/Crypto)
edges.claimed: +0.83c/$ pooled -> 15-50% APR gross with rotation, capacity $9.66B
edges.audit_finding: evidence base entirely external (arXiv 2609.12878, 588M trades to 2026-03-29, 7 months stale); pooled +0.83c vs equal-weight +0.277c and equal-parent +0.392c; repeat buyers earn +0.25% vs +0.88% (adverse selection in the source itself); $9.66B is dollars IN favorites, not harvestable capacity (own pm_baskets shows $600-1100 min-leg liquidity); taker fee rate*p*(1-p) = 0.26-0.33c at p=0.93 = ~1/3 of pooled edge, but models/pm_flb_backtest.py assumes fee=0 AND WAS NEVER RUN (no output file); time-of-entry conflict: arXiv 2610.13593 shows favorites OVERpriced in final 1-12h (bias -0.10 at 6h) while scanner targets markets <=14d with no last-hours ban; sports inverted; Reichenbach&Walther 2025 found no general bias

top3_loss_modes.detail: informed flow sells near-certain winners to systematic buyer; 1 loss per ~14 wins wipes cycle edge
fee ~1/3 of edge; thin ask depth on long-dated favorites; honest 3-8% not 15-50%
1% disputes (geo 4.8%), 43% ambiguous rules, one dispute = -100% of market position; NY lawsuit, proxy wallets, VPN ban -> freeze risk

top3_loss_modes.detail: narrow range x5-10 concentration fills one-sided at worst price; hook exploit -> -30..-100% sleeve
turnover snapshot; fee-APY halves with volumes; 10d persistence << 90d requirement
structural vs event misclassification; range rebalance ops on v4

top3_loss_modes.detail: own backtest negative on all pairs, win 0-8%
enter at spike top via mean reversion; exit threshold triggers on noise -> churn; ADL precedent $2.1B/12min closes profitable short
Bybit AMF blacklist, HL EU grey zone + JELLY intervention precedent; margins on two custodial venues exactly at stress time

edges.name: Loop syrupUSDC/USDC-Maple @5.3x
edges.audit_finding: exact arithmetic on a single-day rate snapshot (2026-10-16): supply ~5.5 / borrow 3.56; no spread history at all; 3.56% is subsidized Maple-market rate in a Fed hike cycle; sensitivity +1pp borrow -> 13.8->9.5%, +2pp -> 5.2%; liquidation at NAV depeg ~14% @5.26x; Maple history $36-54M defaults 2022-23; stack Kamino+Maple+CCIP+oracle p_hack ~1.6-2%/yr x LGD 60-90%; monthly NAV marking can jump buffers at once

top3_loss_modes.detail: hike cycle + our own borrow demand; weekly kill-switch lags; between checks rate can move pp
discrete monthly NAV marks can jump the 14% buffer; cross-chain stack hacks
no observable API field for 'Maple incentives ended'; loop TVL crowding
